projects.name: Drawing Number Auditor
projects.problem: Industrial drawing packages (P&IDs, termination sheets, vendor drawings) must be checked against a TOP list so misnamed or misplaced files are caught.
projects.business_effect: Reduces manual drawing-package QA for engineering turnover packages and lowers the chance of wrong drawings being filed.
projects.automation_flow: Load TOP LIST.xlsx drawing indexes → convert PDF pages to images (Poppler) → crop title-block region → OpenAI vision extracts drawing number → fuzzy-match against filename and expected number → move file into result folders and log CSV.

projects.name: Audit Helper
projects.problem: Large drawing packages need title-block data, revision/approval dates, and stamps checked without reading every PDF by hand.
projects.business_effect: Speeds drawing-package QA and title-block data capture for industrial turnover packages.
projects.automation_flow: Convert PDF pages to images → template-match company title-block ROIs with OpenCV/Tesseract → compare extracted dates/fields to the drawing index → optionally stamp PDFs and write audit/populate CSVs.

projects.name: Turnover Package File Manager
projects.problem: Turnover packages must be assembled from many P&ID, termination, detail, one-line, and location drawings listed on a spreadsheet.
projects.business_effect: Removes repetitive manual filing when assembling engineering turnover packages.
projects.automation_flow: Read TURN OVER PACKAGE TEMPLATE 5.xlsx → clean drawing-number columns → for each package, find matching files in SYSTEM DRAWINGS → copy into destination subfolders → log misses.

projects.name: PDF2Word Form Populator
projects.problem: Form fields on Word templates had to be typed from corresponding PDF packages.
projects.business_effect: Cuts manual transcription from PDF packages into Word forms.
projects.automation_flow: Place PDFs in pkgs and docx templates in forms → render PDF pages (PyMuPDF) → Tesseract OCR → map extracted text into Word fields → save filled forms.

projects.name: Instagram Growth Bot
projects.problem: A client needed to operate many Instagram accounts for growth (follow/like/post) without doing each action manually.
projects.business_effect: Increases capacity to run Instagram growth actions across many accounts with less manual clicking.
projects.automation_flow: Load accounts.txt → spawn Chrome profiles (optional proxies) → login (manual email OTP if needed) → execute follow/like/story/reel-post permissions → persist session profiles.

projects.name: Indeed Employer Resume Scraper
projects.problem: Recruiters needed bulk export of resumes and candidate details from Indeed Employer, which has no convenient bulk download.
projects.business_effect: Reduces manual resume downloading from Indeed Employer and speeds candidate sourcing.
projects.automation_flow: Open employers.indeed.com/candidates → filter by job title or status tab → iterate candidate cards → download resume → append row to CSV and mark Excel sessions Done.

projects.name: DC Sask Work-Package OCR Form Filler
projects.problem: Maintenance/work-package PDFs had to be transcribed into Word forms by hand.
projects.business_effect: Reduces manual data entry from industrial work-package PDFs into forms.
projects.automation_flow: Place PDFs in pkgs → preprocess pages → Tesseract OCR → regex-extract Maximo/location/tag/plant fields → populate docx forms.

projects.name: Dream Companies Property Purchasing Bot
projects.problem: A brokerage needed to submit property offers quickly and repeatedly across CRMLS/CAR/Gmail/e-sign without doing each step manually.
projects.business_effect: Increases offer-submission capacity and shortens time from listing alert to sent offer.
projects.automation_flow: Poll Gmail for ROBOT-tagged MLS emails (or local list) → scrape CRMLS listing → fill CAR transaction/offer forms → wait for signature-request emails → e-sign → draft/send offer email with attachments within a configured time window.

projects.name: WhisperMe
projects.problem: Job seekers need to tailor resumes, mass-apply on job boards, and get live interview help without doing every click and rewrite themselves.
projects.business_effect: Packages resume tailoring, automated job applications, and interview assistance into a credit-based product that can reduce manual apply/interview prep time.
projects.automation_flow: User signs up on wm-website → builds/uploads resume (OpenAI parse) and configures LinkedIn/Dice bots → desktop apps authenticate with API key → fetch resumes/questions/credits → apply on job boards or run interview assistance against wm-backend-server → usage deducted; Stripe webhooks add credits.

projects.name: WhisperMe Autonomous Job Apply Agent
projects.problem: Company career pages and ATS forms (Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, Ashby, etc.) differ too much for hardcoded Easy Apply bots.
projects.business_effect: Extends job-apply automation beyond LinkedIn/Dice Easy Apply to arbitrary ATS forms, increasing apply coverage.
projects.automation_flow: CLI URL + profile.json → navigate with stealth Chrome → classify JD vs form → locate Apply if needed → LLM-guided form fill → submit or dry-run.

projects.name: Browser-as-a-Service (BAAS)
projects.problem: Job-apply and other automations need isolated, fingerprint-resistant browser sessions that can be taken over manually.
projects.business_effect: Provides reusable stealth browser infrastructure so automations scale without each bot managing its own fragile Chrome setup.
projects.automation_flow: API creates a Playwright session from a warm pool → Redis tracks state → client connects via WebSocket/CDP/VNC → automation or human takeover → session timeout/recycle.

projects.name: Instagram Auto DM
projects.problem: Outreach to commenters on Instagram posts is slow if done one-by-one in the app.
projects.business_effect: Increases Instagram comment-to-DM outreach volume versus manual messaging.
projects.automation_flow: One-time login saves scraper and DM sessions → scrape comments from a configured post URL → clean usernames → send message.txt DMs with rate-limit delays.

projects.name: Fredej Anesthesia PDF-to-Word
projects.problem: Consent PDFs linked from a spreadsheet needed to be turned into editable Word files in bulk.
projects.business_effect: Removes per-file download and copy-paste when converting consent PDFs to Word.
projects.automation_flow: Read Anesthesia Consent.xlsx PDF links → download each PDF → extract text with PyPDF2 → write .docx → log status.

projects.name: PrivateEmail Outreach Bot
projects.problem: Bulk or scheduled email from PrivateEmail's web UI is tedious and the web client needs extra clicks.
projects.business_effect: Lets a user send recurring PrivateEmail outreach without sitting in the web composer.
projects.automation_flow: First-time login saves Chrome profile → load contacts → open privateemail.com/appsuite → compose and send (extension can auto-click) → honor schedule window.

projects.name: Clinic Automation (Practice Fusion + Availity)
projects.problem: A clinic had to schedule patients, write notes, check insurance eligibility, and keep an external patient sheet updated across Practice Fusion and Availity.
projects.business_effect: Reduces front-desk and clinical documentation work and speeds insurance eligibility checks for the clinic.
projects.automation_flow: Pull patients from patientsheet.com / YAML bot config → Selenium logs into Practice Fusion → create appointments, update charts, generate SOAP notes (voice/AI) → Availity bot checks eligibility, generates PDF, posts to API → PRN bot writes pfStatus back to patientsheet.com.

projects.name: Alleva Healthcare Operations POC
projects.problem: Care teams on the Alleva EHR had to manually check every active, on-site client to make sure an urgent alert was raised when none had been logged in the past 24 hours.
projects.business_effect: Healthcare demo proof of concept: replaces manual per-client alert checks with a scheduled, idempotent workflow that creates each alert once per day, retries failures safely, and records every action in an audit-ready operations dashboard.
projects.automation_flow: Sync Alleva clients → Filter on-site clients → Check 24h alert rule → Create alert & notify → Audit, retry, dashboard

projects.name: Jerrican NHS Jobs Automation
projects.problem: Healthcare job applicants and agencies need to apply at volume on NHS TRAC and related boards, reuse answers, and write supporting statements.
projects.business_effect: Increases NHS application throughput and reduces manual form-filling and statement writing for an agency/client operation.
projects.automation_flow: Users/agents manage clients on the Flask site → admin agent assigns daily targets → TRAC/Scot/HSCNI bots log in, scrape jobs, fill applications with ChatGPT/RAG answers → status syncs to MongoDB → optional supporting-statement API.

projects.name: NHS Supporting Statement Writer
projects.problem: NHS applications require long supporting statements matched to each vacancy.
projects.business_effect: Sells or packages NHS statement writing so applicants spend less time drafting per vacancy.
projects.automation_flow: User uploads/pastes CV and job description → OpenAI generates statement → web users pay via Stripe; desktop users log in and call /generate_nhs_supporting_statement.

projects.name: UK Universities Course Scraper
projects.problem: Course catalogs needed to be collected into a structured list (title, school, grades, dates, URLs).
projects.business_effect: Builds a course database faster than manual copy from university sites.
projects.automation_flow: Open course listing URL → collect course links → scrape each course page → ChatGPT fills location/London flags → write tabular output.

projects.name: Megan Smith MeritHub Recordings Downloader
projects.problem: Class recordings on merithub.com had to be collected per student from Drive folders by hand.
projects.business_effect: Removes repetitive downloading of student class recordings from MeritHub.
projects.automation_flow: Selenium opens merithub.com users/Drive → find Recordings → scrape title/date/link per student → download in a thread pool, skipping already-saved URLs.

projects.name: Crime Club Game Bot
projects.problem: Repetitive browser game tasks (and captcha friction) needed automation for a client milestone.
projects.business_effect: Reduces time spent repeating in-game tasks in the browser.
projects.automation_flow: Open crime-club.nl → login → run configured task numbers using page text extraction.

projects.name: TTB Business Payment Bot
projects.problem: Bank transfers on ttbbusinessone.com require manual form filling and OTP entry.
projects.business_effect: Speeds repeated business-bank transfers that otherwise need a person at the keyboard for forms and OTPs.
projects.automation_flow: Launch Chromium → restore cookies / login → New payment → PromptPay or account transfer → wait for OTP in otp_messages → submit confirmation.

projects.name: Maison Cuir Leather Storefront
projects.problem: A leather brand needed a storefront page and a written spec document.
projects.business_effect: Gives the brand a public product page and a reusable written spec.
projects.automation_flow: Browse index.html (Tailwind CDN) for the storefront; run build_spec.js to emit a structured .docx specification.

projects.name: Nas.io Payment Bot
projects.problem: Nas.io payment/checkout steps had to be done manually for each charge or link.
projects.business_effect: Lets another system trigger Nas.io payments/links without a person using the Nas.io UI.
projects.automation_flow: POST amount/title/card or payment-link fields → Playwright opens Nas.io → create link or fill payment form → return status; optional IMAP/email listener.

projects.name: UniswapBot
projects.problem: Liquidity-range / swap monitoring on Uniswap required sitting in the browser and MetaMask.
projects.business_effect: Reduces manual watching of Uniswap positions for a configured pair.
projects.automation_flow: User sets network, pair, range, and MetaMask password → bot thread opens Uniswap in Chrome → monitors range/balance and performs configured swap actions.

projects.name: Invoice OCR Experiments
projects.problem: Invoice images needed structured text/table extraction rather than full-page typing.
projects.business_effect: Explores faster invoice data capture; completeness of a single production pipeline is uncertain.
projects.automation_flow: Load invoice image → preprocess/bg-remove or find table contours → Tesseract OCR with coordinates → optional GUI crop → text/table output.

projects.name: Pascoal Tando VFS Visa Bot
projects.problem: VFS Global appointment slots and OTP login are time-sensitive and tedious to retry by hand.
projects.business_effect: Increases chances of completing a VFS appointment without constant manual refreshing and OTP typing.
projects.automation_flow: Open visa.vfsglobal.com/ago/en/prt/login → enter credentials → read OTP from Gmail → continue appointment/booking steps.

projects.name: psuch3 Desktop Data Entry RPA
projects.problem: A Windows app without an API required repetitive project/record data entry.
projects.business_effect: Cuts repetitive desktop data entry for that application.
projects.automation_flow: Match on-screen buttons via PNG templates → type project name/number → tab through fields from a record dict → submit.

projects.name: Randy Dropship & Marketplace Tools
projects.problem: A dropshipper needed fast checkout/address entry across many retailer sites and product data/listing help on marketplaces.
projects.business_effect: Speeds dropship checkout and marketplace sourcing/listing versus doing each site by hand.
projects.automation_flow: User opens a retailer cart/checkout → presses a hotkey → Selenium fills address/checkout notes → scrapers collect listings by keyword → Mercari bot lists items from a spreadsheet.

projects.name: Tick-mark Form Text Extraction
projects.problem: Checked/ticked fields on scanned documents are hard to harvest without reading each page.
projects.business_effect: Can extract answers from ticked paper forms faster than manual review.
projects.automation_flow: Load scanned form + tick template → template match above a threshold → crop ROI next to each tick → Tesseract OCR → save processed images.

projects.name: Twinblu Property Data Platform
projects.problem: Investors needed filtered UK property lists (repossessed, auction, HMO, etc.) without scraping sites by hand each time.
projects.business_effect: Gives a reusable property-research database instead of one-off Rightmove/propertydata searches.
projects.automation_flow: User picks a strategy category and postcode/radius → query MongoDB → if empty, Selenium/scraper pulls live listings → store and display; optional URL spreadsheet checks image status/size.

projects.name: Automation Forge Hub
projects.problem: The freelance automation practice needed a public site to present services and manage leads/projects in-browser.
projects.business_effect: Provides a professional web presence and a place to capture project interest.
projects.automation_flow: Visitor browses services/projects and submits contact; admin routes manage team/projects/settings in the UI (frontend-only as built).
